reviews.review: Was decent very early on but then got tedious and repetitive, people will say that's what makes this game fun thats not true at all whats fun is the fact you are a futuristic warrior that kills eerything in its path but it gets repetitive, plus the DE promised a really cool update and new cinematic quest but kepp delaying it and teasing us with these pointless tiny updates so thats been annoying so I quit. No hard feelings Dev I enjoyed your game for a long time but it just wasnt doing it for me anymore

Before I give you a run down of what I think of this game, let's go back in time to early September; I was dying to play a new game but it was a whole month before any of the big name games were to be released. So I went hunting for a new game to pass the time... but what I found was a game that has almost completely taken over all of my free time for the past month.

Honestly, for a free-to-play game, Warframe offers a lot of content. Yes, the game is really grindy and definitely repetitive but the gameplay, graphics and the awesome community easily make up for that. Now, there are timers and yes, you can pay for stuff. However, since the game doles out rewards and items frequently enough to make the game feel less grindy then it actually is, you never feel forced to buy anything.

Having played this game back in 2013 and after playing it for the past month, I can definitely say that this game has seriously come along way in the past 3 years. Definitely a step above most free-to-play games out there.

Plus, the game has space ninjas!

9/10.

Edit: 700 hours later, I'm still addicted :)

The Duviri Paradox is so disconnected from the core gameplay loop of Warframe, it is both tedious and lackluster. Remove the fast paced movement and combat that the game is known for, add a story that will make no sense to new players and have it be a buggy mess - sounds good to me. Honestly if you're a new player steer clear of the Duviri Paradox, it's a terrible place to start and I hope it gets a massive revamp soon. For something they teased and hyped up for about four years, a massive disappointment.

Amazing game, free to play and super fun for solo or small group play.

Written in 2016. in 2020 this is still the best f2p action game for the western market. The level of complexity is amazing, new gear, mechanics, items, weapons, frames... Just mindblowing!

The grind is real. But at least you get to have fun in the process. And if you decide to support the devs wait for 75% discount and then load up on platinum, it will last you for a long time and devs get to buy some well deserved food.
